cases.watershed: Falls/Jordan Watershed Overlay District B, county jurisdi
proffers: All required street trees to be planted shall be a native species as permitted by Durham Landscape Manual.

within the community, none of which shall be less than 0.5 acres in size. Recreational open space areas must include at least

Dedicated Housing Fund.

unit, a certification that the conduit has been installed will be required before each certificate of occupancy is issued.
Developer shall incorporate a solar photovoltaic system of at least 4KW as part of the development’s clubhouse, community
center, or similar primary amenity structure.

cases.watershed: Little River or in the one-mile critical
proffers: which will benefit the neighbors. Of particular note is text
commitment to provide a public shared connection from the development to the American Tobacco
Trail, which will benefit the entire community.
Given all these circumstances I vote to approve.
CUTRIGHT – I voted to approve this project.
This development seeks to fill a void that continues to expand, which is the need for inexpensive
housing. This is a separate and distinct need from affordable housing, which this particular project
doesn’t address.
This request to amend the zoning from RS-20 to RU-5(D) allows for an incremental 5 homes to be
constructed. It should be noted that its only amends a portion (~30%-40%) of the parcel. While my
fellow commissioners all raised very valid concerns regarding traffic, green building practices and safety
on the AT trail, those concerns would exist if building what's allowable by right. All things being equal,
this rezoning simply allows a few more homes in an area and at a price where they are needed,
increasing supply, which at some point will ease the upwards pricing pressures.
